datasets.name: last_10_runs
queryLines:
SELECT
  run_id,
  run_name,
  run_start_ts,
  warehouse_size,
  total_queries,
  peak_concurrency,
  p50_latency_ms,
  p90_latency_ms,
  p99_latency_ms,
  throughput_qps,
  pct_qrc_hit,
  pct_queued,
  avg_queue_wait_ms,
  client_vs_server_gap_ms
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      r.run_id,
      r.run_name,
      r.run_start_ts,
      r.warehouse_size,
      COUNT(*) AS total_queries,
      MAX(r.target_concurrency) AS peak_concurrency,
      approx_percentile(r.latency_ms, 0.5) AS p50_latency_ms,
      approx_percentile(r.latency_ms, 0.9) AS p90_latency_ms,
      approx_percentile(r.latency_ms, 0.99) AS p99_latency_ms,
      COUNT(*)
        / GREATEST(
          unix_timestamp(MAX(r.end_ts)) - unix_timestamp(MIN(r.start_ts)),
          1
        ) AS throughput_qps,
      100.0
        * SUM(
          CASE
            WHEN r.qrc_hit THEN 1
            ELSE 0
          END
        )
        / COUNT(*) AS pct_qrc_hit,
      100.0
        * SUM(
          CASE
            WHEN
              r.queue_wait_ms > 0
              OR r.provisioning_wait_ms > 0
            THEN
              1
            ELSE 0
          END
        )
        / COUNT(*) AS pct_queued,
      AVG(r.queue_wait_ms) AS avg_queue_wait_ms,
      ROUND(
        approx_percentile(r.latency_ms, 0.5) - approx_percentile(r.server_total_time_ms, 0.5),
        1
      ) AS client_vs_server_gap_ms
    FROM
      sql_benchmark_results r
    GROUP BY
      r.run_id,
      r.run_name,
      r.run_start_ts,
      r.warehouse_size
  )
ORDER BY
  run_start_ts DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: concurrency_comparison
datasets.displayName: Latency by Concurrency Step (A vs B)
queryLines:
SELECT
  'Run A' AS run_label,
  target_concurrency,
  approx_percentile(server_total_time_ms, 0.5) AS p50_latency_ms
FROM
  sql_benchmark_results
WHERE
  run_id = split_part(:run_id_a, ' | ', 1)
  AND server_total_time_ms IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  target_concurrency
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Run B' AS run_label,
  target_concurrency,
  approx_percentile(server_total_time_ms, 0.5) AS p50_latency_ms
FROM
  sql_benchmark_results
WHERE
  run_id = split_part(:run_id_b, ' | ', 1)
  AND server_total_time_ms IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  target_concurrency

datasets.name: run_options
queryLines:
SELECT
  run_id,
  run_name,
  run_start_ts,
  concat(run_id, ' | ', coalesce(run_name, 'None')) AS run_label
FROM
  (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      run_id,
      run_name,
      run_start_ts
    FROM
      sql_benchmark_results
  )
ORDER BY
  run_id DESC

datasets.name: run_comparison_vertical
queryLines:
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
    run_id,
    MAX(run_name) AS run_name,
    MAX(run_start_ts) AS run_start_ts,
    MAX(warehouse_size) AS warehouse_size,
    MAX(warehouse_min_clusters) AS min_clusters,
    MAX(warehouse_max_clusters) AS max_clusters,
    COUNT(*) AS total_queries,
    MAX(target_concurrency) AS peak_concurrency,
    approx_percentile(latency_ms, 0.5) AS p50_latency_ms,
    approx_percentile(latency_ms, 0.9) AS p90_latency_ms,
    approx_percentile(latency_ms, 0.99) AS p99_latency_ms,
    COUNT(*)
      / GREATEST(unix_timestamp(MAX(end_ts)) - unix_timestamp(MIN(start_ts)), 1) AS throughput_qps,
    100.0
      * SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN qrc_hit THEN 1
          ELSE 0
        END
      )
      / COUNT(*) AS pct_qrc_hit,
    100.0
      * SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN
            queue_wait_ms > 0
            OR provisioning_wait_ms > 0
          THEN
            1
          ELSE 0
        END
      )
      / COUNT(*) AS pct_queued,
    AVG(queue_wait_ms) AS avg_queue_wait_ms,
    ROUND(
      approx_percentile(latency_ms, 0.5) - approx_percentile(server_total_time_ms, 0.5),
      1
    ) AS client_vs_server_gap_ms
  FROM
    sql_benchmark_results
  WHERE
    run_id IN (split_part(:run_id_a, ' | ', 1), split_part(:run_id_b, ' | ', 1))
  GROUP BY
    run_id
),
a AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    agg
  WHERE
    run_id = split_part(:run_id_a, ' | ', 1)
),
b AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    agg
  WHERE
    run_id = split_part(:run_id_b, ' | ', 1)
)
SELECT
  stack(
    14,
    1,
    'Run Name',
    CAST(coalesce(a.run_name, 'None') AS STRING),
    CAST(coalesce(b.run_name, 'None') AS STRING),
    2,
    'Start Time',
    CAST(a.run_start_ts AS STRING),
    CAST(b.run_start_ts AS STRING),
    3,
    'Warehouse Size',
    a.warehouse_size,
    b.warehouse_size,
    4,
    'Autoscaling Range',
    CAST(a.min_clusters AS STRING) || ' - ' || CAST(a.max_clusters AS STRING),
    CAST(b.min_clusters AS STRING) || ' - ' || CAST(b.max_clusters AS STRING),
    5,
    'Total Queries',
    CAST(a.total_queries AS STRING),
    CAST(b.total_queries AS STRING),
    6,
    'Peak Concurrency',
    CAST(a.peak_concurrency AS STRING),
    CAST(b.peak_concurrency AS STRING),
    7,
    'P50 Latency (ms)',
    CAST(ROUND(a.p50_latency_ms, 1) AS STRING),
    CAST(ROUND(b.p50_latency_ms, 1) AS STRING),
    8,
    'P90 Latency (ms)',
    CAST(ROUND(a.p90_latency_ms, 1) AS STRING),
    CAST(ROUND(b.p90_latency_ms, 1) AS STRING),
    9,
    'P99 Latency (ms)',
    CAST(ROUND(a.p99_latency_ms, 1) AS STRING),
    CAST(ROUND(b.p99_latency_ms, 1) AS STRING),
    10,
    'Throughput (QPS)',
    CAST(ROUND(a.throughput_qps, 2) AS STRING),
    CAST(ROUND(b.throughput_qps, 2) AS STRING),
    11,
    'QRC Hit %',
    CAST(ROUND(a.pct_qrc_hit, 1) AS STRING),
    CAST(ROUND(b.pct_qrc_hit, 1) AS STRING),
    12,
    '% Queued',
    CAST(ROUND(a.pct_queued, 1) AS STRING),
    CAST(ROUND(b.pct_queued, 1) AS STRING),
    13,
    'Avg Queue Wait (ms)',
    CAST(ROUND(a.avg_queue_wait_ms, 1) AS STRING),
    CAST(ROUND(b.avg_queue_wait_ms, 1) AS STRING),
    14,
    'Client vs Server Gap (ms)',
    COALESCE(CAST(a.client_vs_server_gap_ms AS STRING), 'N/A'),
    COALESCE(CAST(b.client_vs_server_gap_ms AS STRING), 'N/A')
  ) AS (sort_order, metric, run_a, run_b)
FROM
  a CROSS JOIN b
ORDER BY
  sort_order

datasets.name: ramp_curve_a
queryLines:
WITH ramp_curve AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(unix_timestamp(start_ts) - unix_timestamp(MIN(start_ts) OVER ()) AS INT) AS elapsed_sec,
    target_concurrency,
    server_total_time_ms
  FROM
    sql_benchmark_results
  WHERE
    run_id = split_part(:run_id_a, ' | ', 1)
    AND server_total_time_ms IS NOT NULL
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    elapsed_sec,
    MAX(target_concurrency) AS concurrency,
    approx_percentile(server_total_time_ms, 0.5) AS p50_latency_ms,
    approx_percentile(server_total_time_ms, 0.9) AS p90_latency_ms,
    approx_percentile(server_total_time_ms, 0.99) AS p99_latency_ms,
    COUNT(*) AS queries_started
  FROM
    ramp_curve
  GROUP BY
    elapsed_sec
)
SELECT
  *
FROM
  agg
WHERE
  elapsed_sec
    < (
      SELECT
        MAX(elapsed_sec)
      FROM
        agg
    )
ORDER BY
  elapsed_sec

datasets.name: queued_by_concurrency
datasets.displayName: Queued Queries by Concurrency (A vs B)
queryLines:
WITH base_a AS (
  SELECT
    target_concurrency,
    queue_wait_ms,
    provisioning_wait_ms,
    CAST(unix_timestamp(start_ts) - unix_timestamp(MIN(start_ts) OVER ()) AS INT) AS elapsed_sec
  FROM
    sql_benchmark_results
  WHERE
    run_id = split_part(:run_id_a, ' | ', 1)
),
base_b AS (
  SELECT
    target_concurrency,
    queue_wait_ms,
    provisioning_wait_ms,
    CAST(unix_timestamp(start_ts) - unix_timestamp(MIN(start_ts) OVER ()) AS INT) AS elapsed_sec
  FROM
    sql_benchmark_results
  WHERE
    run_id = split_part(:run_id_b, ' | ', 1)
)
SELECT
  'Run A' AS run_label,
  target_concurrency,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN
        queue_wait_ms > 0
        OR provisioning_wait_ms > 0
      THEN
        1
      ELSE 0
    END
  )
    / GREATEST(COUNT(DISTINCT elapsed_sec), 1) AS queued_per_sec
FROM
  base_a
GROUP BY
  target_concurrency
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Run B' AS run_label,
  target_concurrency,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN
        queue_wait_ms > 0
        OR provisioning_wait_ms > 0
      THEN
        1
      ELSE 0
    END
  )
    / GREATEST(COUNT(DISTINCT elapsed_sec), 1) AS queued_per_sec
FROM
  base_b
GROUP BY
  target_concurrency
ORDER BY
  target_concurrency

datasets.name: client_vs_server
datasets.displayName: Client vs Server Latency by Concurrency
queryLines:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    run_id,
    CASE
      WHEN run_id = split_part(:run_id_a, ' | ', 1) THEN 'Run A'
      ELSE 'Run B'
    END AS run_label,
    target_concurrency,
    latency_ms,
    server_total_time_ms
  FROM
    sql_benchmark_results
  WHERE
    run_id IN (split_part(:run_id_a, ' | ', 1), split_part(:run_id_b, ' | ', 1))
    AND server_total_time_ms IS NOT NULL
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    run_label,
    target_concurrency,
    approx_percentile(latency_ms, 0.5) AS p50_client_ms,
    approx_percentile(server_total_time_ms, 0.5) AS p50_server_ms
  FROM
    base
  GROUP BY
    run_label,
    target_concurrency
)
SELECT
  target_concurrency,
  series,
  latency_ms
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      target_concurrency,
      CONCAT(run_label, ' - Client') AS series,
      p50_client_ms AS latency_ms
    FROM
      agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      target_concurrency,
      CONCAT(run_label, ' - Server') AS series,
      p50_server_ms AS latency_ms
    FROM
      agg
  )
ORDER BY
  target_concurrency
